artifact: Objective 6 English fact-aware report-generation v2 protocol

development_evaluation.if_no_candidate_passes: publish the negative v2 development result and do not evaluate the original Objective 6 locked test
development_evaluation.if_one_candidate_passes: freeze every parameter, threshold, translator, retriever, prompt, controller, and metric before one original locked-test evaluation
selection_rule: macro concept F1 gain over the frozen v1.1 reference at least 0.05
unique generated report fraction at least 0.25

english_reference_pipeline.PadChest_GR_if_licensed_and_available: may be used only as external bilingual training supervision and translation validation after patient de-duplication; absence does not change the locked primary pipeline
english_reference_pipeline.execution: local private Kaggle inference; no translation API
english_reference_pipeline.normalisation: Unicode NFC, whitespace normalization, preserve measurements and remove neither negations nor uncertainty expressions

private_v2_development_partition.algorithm: rank unique private patient identifiers by SHA-256 of objective6-v2|seed|patient and assign the first rounded 20 percent to development
private_v2_development_partition.source: the original Objective 6 training cohort only

scientific_separation.rationale: v2 changes the report language, cohort-development boundary, clinical planner, retrieval mechanism, decoder pretraining, and factual objective; it is not represented as a continuation of v1.1

status: locked after the immutable negative v1.1 decision and before v2 translation, model fitting, generation, or locked-test access

candidate_1.name: fact_aware_retrieve_edit_english
candidate_1.report_controller: sentence-level English retrieve-and-edit with predicted-positive insertion, predicted-negative contradiction removal, and an uncertainty-preserving abstention rule

candidate_2.final_stage: one short self-critical sequence-training stage using a locked clinical factuality, semantic similarity, CIDEr-D, contradiction, and diversity reward
candidate_2.name: fact_aware_retrieval_augmented_english_generator
candidate_2.planner: multi-label clinical plan trained on v2-training PadChest/UMLS labels; ground-truth labels are never decoder inputs at inference
candidate_2.visual_encoder: Objective 5 PadChest-adapted DenseNet-121 initialized from SHA-256 109db89a723c6e2f24442cb5866bfcf4084e85083936cda91bce3b8ae4365d9d
